name: roll iliopsoas
description: A roller or ball release for the deep hip flexor area at the front of the pelvis.
instructions: Lie face down with the roller under the front of one hip, just inside the hip bone.
Support your weight on your forearms.
Shift your weight gently over the roller.
Roll slowly a small distance up and down.
Pause on tight spots while breathing deeply.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
